div.div:
src/db/client.td - DbClient
- private static instance : DbClient
+getInstance(): DbClinet <- one connection only
+disconnect(): void
Why Singleton?
-PostgreSQL has connection limits
-Opening conneciton per tes wastes resources
-One shared connection across entire test suite
-Closed once in afterAll()

text.tspan: -One shared connection across entire test suite
